objective: Harden, optimize, and rewrite backend with Gravitas reliability runtime
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Secure domain matching prevents domain substring injection (rejects youtube.com.attacker.com, etc.)
AC-2: DownloadQueryDto accepts valid DASH yt-dlp format strings (e.g. 137+bestaudio[ext=m4a]/best) while preventing shell injection
AC-3: ConcurrencyService prevents unbounded queue growth with max queue limit and telemetry
AC-4: BinaryService uses atomic file downloads, timeouts, and corrupted binary recovery
AC-5: StreamProxyService enforces SSRF checks on redirect targets and prevents premature stream timeout truncation
AC-6: MediaService adds child process timeouts (30s/90s), client abort handling, and auto-cleanup of stale temp files
AC-7: MediaController adds LiteSpeed SSE non-buffering headers, UTF-8 Content-Disposition, and health check endpoint
AC-8: Comprehensive test coverage for all updated modules with 100% passing tests and clean production build
non_goals: Do not introduce external database or Redis
Do not break compatibility with frontend API contracts
